title: Paying too late after a yes
story: The Guard allows a INR 1,250 payment, but ShopBot gets distracted and only tries to pay after the 15-minute Payment window has closed. The payment is refused with PAYMENT_WINDOW_CLOSED: ShopBot must ask again, against Asha's limits as they are now.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Allowed. I'll pay in a moment...

what_to_notice: An allow is a yes for a short while only. The Decision itself never changes; the window it opened ended, so the payment is refused and a new request would be decided afresh.
